title: Apple Music on macOS Tahoe 26
lede: The Music app in macOS Tahoe 26: opaque album content under a floating glass sidebar and a floating glass player bar.
summary: Album art runs under a floating glass sidebar and player capsule. Apple, 2025.

evidence.note: Inspected the Apple Newsroom image Apple-WWDC25-macOS-Tahoe-26-Apple-Music-250609 (1960 × 1306, large_2x variant) in a scratchpad copy. A press render. Not stored.

styles.note: A clear case of the two layers: opaque content, with glass only on the sidebar, the player controls, and the Dock.

context: Apple: in macOS Tahoe 26 “the Dock, sidebars, and toolbars have been refined, bringing greater focus to a user’s content”. [Apple Newsroom](https://www.apple.com/newsroom/2025/06/macos-tahoe-26-makes-the-mac-more-capable-productive-and-intelligent-than-ever/).

The HIG: Liquid Glass “forms a distinct functional layer for controls and navigation elements — like tab bars and sidebars — that floats above the content layer”. [Apple HIG: Materials](https://developer.apple.com/design/human-interface-guidelines/materials).
observed: A MacBook screen with a blue wave wallpaper, a transparent menu bar, and glass calendar and weather widgets on the desktop.
The Music window is opaque white with a large black “Home” title and rows of square album art with rounded corners.
The sidebar is a separate rounded panel inset inside the window, lighter than the content, with a faint pink and blue glow from the content beside it. Its selected item is a grey capsule.
A white player capsule floats over the lower row of album art, inset from the window edges. The art shows faintly through its edges.
The Dock is a long glass strip inset from the screen edge, with a lit upper rim.
interpretation: Here the glass is quiet. The style shows mainly in the floating, inset shapes and the content that runs under them, not in strong transparency.
borrow: Float the media player as a capsule above the scrolling content instead of docking it as a full-width bar.

rights.statement: Apple press image of copyrighted software and third-party album art. No image is stored here.
